labelChirho: Kedar (proper noun, son of Ishmael / Arabian tribe)
descriptionChirho: The proper noun Qedar refers to the second son of Ishmael (Genesis 25:13) and by extension the nomadic Arabian tribe descended from him, dwelling in the Syrian-Arabian desert. All four clusters represent the same referent with purely syntactic variation: bare name (Qedar), with conjunctive waw (we-Qedar 'and Kedar'), another bare name occurrence, and with preposition lamed (le-Qedar 'concerning Kedar'). Transliterations are consistent across languages: Arabic Qidar (قيدار), Spanish Cedar/Kedar/Quedar, Korean 게달 (Gedal), Swahili Kedari, Hindi केदार (Kedar). The tribe is referenced in Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Song of Songs, and the genealogical lists of Genesis and Chronicles.
